fusions.name: Painless Incision
fusions.desc: A small cut that deals 4 damage, leaves the target 5% easier to wound for 3 seconds and [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds. You heal for 30% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Thrown by Ear
fusions.desc: Throws a knife up to 12 tiles that deals 28 damage to the first enemy it meets. It is always a critical hit, and it leaves the target [Marked] for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Wingbeat Hush
fusions.desc: Veils you in darkness for 5 seconds. You move 33% faster, enemies notice you 60% later, and the veil breaks when you attack.

fusions.name: Banked Near Misses
fusions.desc: Every blow you dodge builds a stack on you, up to 5. The next ability you use spends them all: you deal 6% more damage per stack (30% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
